verdict.rationale: The only evidence of user-controlled deletion is a community report that a paid account can be deleted 'and everything in it' (comm-7). The docs add an account-export endpoint (docs-16), which covers data portability rather than deletion. Nothing in the pack documents configurable retention periods or API-level deletion of contacts or data. missing for 10: documented retention-period controls, API or UI deletion of contacts and personal data, first-party privacy or erasure documentation, independent corroboration.
